title: Productive Manifestations of Learning Outcomes
content: The goal of this paper is to examine the conditions that help develop productive capability in individuals. Productivity is an enabler. Herein, we discuss the theoretical factors that confer stability to productive practice necessary for the achievement of individual or organisational success. Success is the result of outcomes. The importance of learning in this respect is highlighted in productive purview, as it is well acknowledged how learning confers strength in helping nurture capability to become productive. We contend that the outcomes of learning, if positive, have explicit relation with productivity. With this aim in purview, we presume productive manifestations of learning outcomes to be perfunctory, and which becomes visible in the form of revealed effects. This paper discusses these aspects of productivity and examines how learning outcomes are explicitly linked to productiveness of an individual or a system.
